subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Heavy Strength (Wk 1)
html:
Tomorrow: Heavy Strength — Cañada College (W1 Calibration)

This is your first barbell session of the V6 plan. The goal isn't to go heavy — it's to find your working weights. Every exercise uses the calibration protocol: warm up the movement, then build to a top set of 6 that feels Good (2–3 reps in reserve). Whatever weight that lands on becomes your working load for the remaining sets and the Week 2 baseline.

Dynamic warm-up: Foam roll quads & IT band (1 min each) → glute bridges (10 reps) → hip CARs (3 each direction, each leg) → bodyweight squats (10 reps) → RDL pattern with empty bar (10 reps).

The session (3–4 sets × 6–8 reps, 3-sec eccentric):

ExerciseCalibration SeedWarm-Up Ramp
Back Squat135 lb45×10 → 95×5 → 115×5 → build to top set of 6
Romanian Deadlift155 lb45×10 → 95×5 → 135×5 → build to top set of 6
Reverse NordicBodyweight3×8 — 3-sec lower, knees together
Standing Calf Raise30 lb/hand DBs3×10 — full ROM, 2-sec hold at top

Focus cue: The 3-second eccentric is non-negotiable. Count "one-thousand-one, one-thousand-two, one-thousand-three" on every squat and RDL descent. If you can't control the tempo at the weight you've picked, it's too heavy — drop 10 lb and own the movement. Controlled eccentrics are what build the structural durability your knee needs for the next 11 weeks.

Context: Week 1 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation & Durability — 81 days to race day. Knee has been 1/5 through yesterday's 8.4-mile track session (5×1000m, max HR 190) and every run this block. That's four straight clean readings — exactly the signal that says the V6 ramp is working. Report your feel ratings for each exercise so I can set Week 2 loads accurately.

Prep tonight: Lay out gym clothes and pack your bag — Cañada opens early. Have a solid meal tonight with protein (aim for 30g+). Coffee and a banana 30–45 min before is enough pre-lift fuel. Get to bed by 10; yesterday's track session taxed the nervous system and sleep is where you consolidate those gains.
